verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1 lists eight universities: Brown, Columbia, Cornell, Dartmouth, Harvard, Princeton, UPenn, Yale; R2: 'group of eight historic, prestigious schools... all Ivy League schools are located in the eastern United States'; R3: 'eight elite private universities'; R6: 'eight private universities in the northeastern United States'; R8: 'eight private colleges located in the northeast of America'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state the Ivy League has eight private universities in the Northeast/eastern US.

verifications.claim: The Ivy League was originally formed as an athletic conference in 1954.

verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently identify 1954 as the year the Ivy League athletic conference was formally established or extended to all sports, originating as athletic.
